name: Ranmasu Uyana
description: Ranmasu Uyana, a national park in Anuradhapura, offers visitors opportunities to observe wildlife and engage in hiking. The park, established as a sanctuary for elephants, provides a glimpse into Sri Lanka's rich biodiversity. Historically, Ranmasu Uyana was part of the ancient royal palace complex, where the royal family would keep their elephants. Today, it serves as a vital habitat for several endangered species, including Asian elephants, making it a crucial conservation site. Visitors can explore trails that wind through lush vegetation, offering a chance to see native flora and fauna in their natural environment.
